name: Fountains on the Lake
summary: Fountains on the Lake is a community shopping center in Stafford, Texas, serving the Fort Bend County area with a convenient mix of retail stores and dining options. The open-air center maintains strong local appeal with its accessible location and family-friendly atmosphere.
demographics: Fountains on the Lake attracts a diverse mix of suburban families and professionals from the Stafford and greater Fort Bend County area, with household incomes ranging from middle to upper-middle class. The trade area serves a growing population of young families and established homeowners, with a significant representation of dual-income households seeking convenient shopping and dining options. Visitors typically range from 25-55 years old, with strong purchasing power and preferences for quality retailers and family-friendly amenities in a comfortable outdoor setting.
description: Fountains on the Lake is a well-established community shopping center located in Stafford, Texas, offering residents and visitors a convenient retail and dining destination in the heart of Fort Bend County. Situated at 12520 Fountain Lake Circle, this open-air center provides a comfortable shopping experience with ample parking and easy accessibility from major thoroughfares. The center maintains strong community appeal with its mix of national retailers, local businesses, and dining establishments that cater to the everyday needs of area families and professionals. With operating hours from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM daily, Fountains on the Lake serves as a reliable neighborhood hub for shopping, services, and casual dining. The center's 4.5-star rating from over 2,450 reviews reflects its consistent performance and positive reception among local shoppers who appreciate its convenient location and tenant mix.
